programs.title: House Hunters
programs.sub_title: Dogs Go Coastal in Grassy Key, Florida
programs.desc: After a romantic getaway, a couple knows the Florida Keys is the place to find their paradise home; they want a waterfront property, and she wants a big yard for their dogs, but his priorities are something that's turnkey with lots of light.

programs.title: 100 Day Dream Home
programs.desc: After years of living with family, a couple's finally ready to build a home of their own. They want to downsize, but with a wish list that's anything but small, Brian and Mika aim to make it all happen with a massive garage for boats and a trailer.

programs.title: 100 Day Dream Home
programs.desc: After a couple's home is destroyed by a hurricane, their biggest challenge isn't rebuilding, the real disaster occurs with their battle over paint colors. And now, Brian and Mika are tasked with making sure that one of them doesn't get too blue.

programs.title: 100 Day Dream Home
programs.desc: A couple looks to build an addition to their home, so his mom can move in; design sparks fly when he wants all white, and she craves bold color in their new main suite, so Brian and Mika are challenged to create a space that makes everyone happy.

programs.title: 100 Day Dream Home
programs.desc: After traveling the world for the military, a couple have agreed to settle down in Tampa, Florida; while they're united on location, they're divided on design, so Mika takes a big risk to try and satisfy everyone, but Brian worries it may backfire.

programs.title: Home Town: Inn This Together
programs.desc: Ben and Erin help their best friends turn a dilapidated 1930s department store into Laurel's first boutique hotel; with crushing financial risks and six months to open, they must finish a prototype room to secure bookings.
